The multiples of 7 between 100 and 200 are 105, 112, 119, ..., 196.  
The first multiple is \(15 \times 7 = 105\) and the last is \(28 \times 7 = 196\).  
The number of terms is \(28 - 15 + 1 = 14\).  
The sum of an arithmetic series is \(\frac{n}{2}(\text{first} + \text{last})\).  
Sum = \(\frac{14}{2}(105 + 196) = 7 \times 301 = 2107\).  
(Note: A common mistake is forgetting to divide by 2, which doubles the total to 4214.)

Answer: 2107
